All Classes and Interfaces

Class
Description
AIConfig
An app's AI configuration, loaded and validated by AIConfigLoader: the gateways of its parent (global) file, the models the app uses with their merged settings, and the app's roots, named pools of entry models.
AIConfigException
A config file that is missing, unreadable or breaks a rule.
AIConfigLoader
Loads an app's AI configuration: its app file and the global file the app file names as its parent.
AIHub
The entry point of the AI model hub: sends an app's jobs to the models of its AIConfig, binding each job to a model as late as possible, with per-model slots, provider and app rate limits, retries and guarded fallbacks, and reports through each job's JobListener.
AIHub.Options
How a hub runs.
AIJob<P,R>
Work for the hub: what to ask, where it may start, and who to tell.
AIJob.RequestFactory
Builds a job's request for one attempt.
AIReply
A model's answer to one request.
AIRequest
What to ask a model: a prompt and the images that go with it.
AIRequest.Image
An image, base64 encoded once so retries don't encode it again.
Attempt
One request of a job, as it goes out.
AttemptResult
How an Attempt ended.
AttemptResult.Outcome
How an attempt ended.
Candidate
A waiting job a model slot may take, offered to the RoutingPolicy.
Candidate.Via
Why a job may run on a model.
FailureKind
Why an attempt failed, or why a model is held back, as far as fallback is concerned.
FallbackInfo
Where a job goes after a model fails it for good: an ordered list of models per failure kind, and a default list for the kinds without one.
GatewayInfo
A gateway as the global config defines it: where models are hosted and what the provider enforces.
GatewayType
The transports a gateway can use, by their type in the config.
HubStatus
A snapshot of the hub, cheap enough to poll every second.
HubStatus.GatewayStatus
 
HubStatus.Jobs
 
HubStatus.ModelStatus
 
HubStatus.Notice
A gateway, or one of its models, held back by a limit.
HubStatus.Request
A request in flight.
HubStatus.WaitingJob
A job waiting for a model: before its first attempt, or between attempts.
HubView
The state of the hub's models as a RoutingPolicy sees it while it picks.
JobContext<P>
What the hub tells its callbacks about a job.
JobHandle
The app's hold on a submitted job.
JobHandle.State
Where a job is.
JobListener<P,R>
Follows one job through the hub.
ModelInfo
A model as an app uses it: the global definition (where it is hosted, the provider's limits) merged with the app's policy for it.
ModelSlot
A model slot that is free and may send now, asking the RoutingPolicy for a job.
Priority
Where a submitted job joins the waiting jobs.
RateLimit
Requests allowed per minute and per UTC day (reset at 00:00 UTC); 0 means no limit.
ReplyCheck<R>
The app's verdict on a reply (JobListener.check(com.sandy.sconsole.ai.JobContext<P>, com.sandy.sconsole.ai.Attempt, com.sandy.sconsole.ai.AIReply)).
ReplyCheck.Accept<R>
The reply is the job's result.
ReplyCheck.Escalate<R>
The reply will do, but another root should be asked: the job goes on to the models of root (not the one that replied).
ReplyCheck.Reject<R>
The reply is no use: the attempt fails as FailureKind.BAD_REPLY and the job retries or falls back as for any failure.
RoutingPolicy
The app's say in which job a model takes.
TokenUsage
Tokens one request used, as the gateway reported them.
